therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: pediatric patients with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia and acute lymphoblastic leukemia
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: maximum tolerated dose (MTD) based on dose limiting toxicity probability

results.effect_size: MTD established with DLT probability 0.03-0.10 across dose cohorts
results.target_engagement_evidence: plasma concentrations of midostaurin and metabolites CGP52421 and CGP62221 demonstrated dose-proportional exposure
subgroup_findings: Median time to response: AML 14.0 days, MLLr-ALL 8.0 days
results.dose_information: 30 mg/m2 BID (cohort 1) and 60 mg/m2 BID (cohort 2), oral solution

context.duration: up to 24 months treatment with follow-up
